prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL high-quality game sprite atlas for an underwater arcade fish table. Canvas 2048x1024, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 equally sized cells, eight isolated full-body sprites, one centered in each cell with generous 35px safe margins, no overlap across cells. Transparent background, actual alpha, no grid, no text, no labels, no water or scenery, no shadows beyond sprite silhouettes. Polished colorful sculpted 3D arcade rendering, crisp modeled fins/scales, warm highlights and defined silhouettes readable at small game sizes; playful aquatic fantasy with realistic materials, NOT flat clip art. Each creature points/swims toward the RIGHT and viewed slightly from above. Row1 col1: long sinuous red-orange and gold aquatic dragon with horns, whiskers, fins, curled slender tail, full body fitting cell. Row1 col2: regal adult mermaid, opaque turquoise/gold scale bodice and long flowing green-gold fish tail, auburn flowing hair, swimming horizontally right, no nudity, no human legs. Row1 col3: orange armored king crab with two impressive claws and pearl studded shell, top-down three-quarter view facing right. Row1 col4: deep-violet spotted manta ray with long tail, top-down three-quarter facing right. Row2 col1: gold and turquoise ornate seahorse, curved tail and translucent fins, facing right. Row2 col2: coral red lobster with segmented curved tail, legs and long claws, facing right. Row2 col3: ONE tiny slender silver-blue sardine, streamlined body, sparkling scales and small fins, facing right. Row2 col4: ONE small bright lemon-yellow reef fish with blue fin edges, narrow shape, facing right. Every creature is standalone original artwork for integration into a playable scene, not a mockup. Maintain consistent lighting/material finish; retain empty transparent cell backgrounds.
